Container.Name: deepseek-harness-dind
Container.Overview: Privileged Docker-in-Docker daemon for workloads launched by the DeepSeek Harness desktop. Select the same existing user-defined Docker network for this container and the desktop. Keep the container name deepseek-harness-dind so the desktop endpoint and TLS certificate match. The Docker API uses client-authenticated TLS on container port 2376; no Unraid host port mapping is needed. Start this container first so it generates the client certificates.

Config.Name: Docker data
Config.Description: Persistent DinD image, container, and volume data.

Config.Name: Docker TLS certificates
Config.Description: Persistent TLS certificates. The desktop receives only the client subdirectory as a read-only mount.

Config.Name: DinD TLS certificate directory
Config.Description: Enables the official DinD image's client-authenticated TLS API on container port 2376. Do not add an Unraid Port mapping.

Config.Name: DinD TLS server DNS name
Config.Description: Adds the stable container name to the DinD server certificate so the desktop can verify its TLS endpoint.
